conclusion: OTL1 compresses repetitive, textual and structured payloads strongly, leaves incompressible random data at roughly unit ratio, and always round-trips byte-exactly. Because the compressed payload determines the number of packets, compression directly reduces screen time. OTL1 does not claim to beat zlib/zstd on general data; its purpose is a small, deterministic, inspectable instruction stream.

summary.note: OTL1 is a deterministic, dependency-free dictionary codec designed for the on-screen instruction set; zlib/zstd numbers are references, not part of the protocol.

title: Shared instruction dictionary (OTL1) compression effectiveness
